headline: Pix is 6 years old and already accounts for more than half of payments in Brazil
summary: Pix, Brazil's instant payment system, now accounts for more than half of payments in the country. It has expanded from person-to-person transfers into commerce, credit, recurring payments and international operations.
why: Pix is run by the Central Bank of Brazil and has reshaped payments, competing with card networks and fintech firms in Latin America's largest economy.
